email.body1:
AJ, saw Prove launch the unified Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world, plus the Ireland expansion.

A platform launch plus expansion usually opens more in-market accounts than the growth team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
AJ, quick follow-up for Prove.

After a platform launch, expectations on growth pipeline climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the growth team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
AJ, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to peer identity platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
AJ, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling growth pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a platform launch, and I know turning that into pipeline is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a growth motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
